name: smwmusic-touhou-kinjoukyou-falsified-wonders-daemon-invariant
title: Touhou Kinjoukyou ~ Falsified Wonders - Daemon Invariant
description:
Shinko Kuroyama's theme from 東方近状況　〜 Falsified Wonders, an album of prediction tracks for Fossilized Wonders.

It's somewhat tense and ouroboric, perhaps, and a certified banger. It was also quite a porting exercise, condensing all that polyphony into 8 channels.

A big thank you to Eiki Shiki for giving me the MIDI for the original song.
